scenarios.name: Switch between the source and target selectors

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible
ribbon customization shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target
there are no pending customization changes
the user opens the command-source list
the user clicks the target selector
the command-source list closes
the target list is not open
the user clicks the target selector again
the target list opens with Part Tools selected
the user clicks the command-source selector
the target list closes
the command-source list is not open
the user clicks the command-source selector again
the command-source list opens with All Commands selected
the user clicks Close
the command-source list closes
the customization dialog remains open
the user clicks Close again
the customization dialog closes
the Tools ribbon remains visible
